details: U.S. spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs saw approximately $1.1 billion in inflows during the week ending August 7, marking the best combined inflow week since April. Bitcoin ETFs alone attracted $853.5 million over five consecutive days of inflows, with BlackRock's IBIT capturing a significant portion. This surge indicates renewed institutional interest in regulated crypto exposure.
title: Institutional Crypto ETF Inflows Hit Record High

details: A firmware exploit in Coldcard hardware wallets led to over $110 million in Bitcoin being drained from approximately 5,000 wallets. The vulnerability specifically affected seeds generated without the manual dice-roll option, raising renewed concerns about self-custody security within the crypto community.
title: Coldcard Hardware Wallet Exploit Drains Millions

details: The U.S. Senate has advanced the Crypto Clarity Act, with a full vote anticipated on September 15. This legislative progress aims to provide greater regulatory clarity for the cryptocurrency industry, a development long sought by market participants for fostering innovation and mainstream adoption.
title: US Senate Advances Crypto Clarity Act

details: A new Ethereum proposal suggests burning staking rewards to zero if half of the ETH supply is staked, potentially cutting issuance if staked ETH reaches $112 billion. While proponents aim to rein in staking, critics express concerns that this move could backfire and impact the network's economics.
title: Ethereum Staking Rewards Proposal Sparks Debate

details: XRP's open interest surged by 7% in the last 24 hours, reaching $2.52 billion, even as Bitcoin and Ethereum experienced drops in open interest. This rise suggests increased capital inflows and positive sentiment among XRP traders, following recent developments and the release of XRP Ledger version 3.3.0 with new amendments and bug fixes.
title: XRP Open Interest Sees Significant Increase
